C1a.mechanism: M5 in-shape: each request's circuit is its streamed length; no advice
C1a.notes: 36 tokens streamed of 48 asked; lengths (1, 5, 7, 3, 11, 9) (3 EOS stops); U = 576 bits (interface-capped); 604.1 gates/token; the length would be output-determined advice (charged 0) if it had to be advice at all.
C1a.verdict: no advice: lengths are public (the client sees the stream end), route (c)
C1a.what: variable-length generation, request RUs: 6 requests, max_new 3..13, EOS stops

C1b.mechanism: M4 charged advice: the schedule (Schedule.encode(): a header and 7 words per join)
C1b.notes: U = 576 bits (interface-capped) + 1632 advice bits for 6 joins over 19 steps; 604.1 gates/token (same work, cut into steps); overhead 1.12 vs 0.61 with request RUs: the KV cache crosses every step boundary. The per-request lengths are output-determined; only the placement (pod, slot, step) is genuine advice.
C1b.verdict: advice = the schedule; each request's length rides in its join (28 bytes)
C1b.what: variable-length generation, step RUs (ClusterG, 1 pod x 2 slots): the same requests

C2a.mechanism: M5 in-circuit decision: router_topk VU (rank by lt chains) masks the experts' outputs
C2a.notes: 7 tokens; 1326.4 gates/token vs 733.1 advised (1.81x); U = 112 bits = the interface (capped); route check 0 bits.
C2a.verdict: no advice, E/k times the expert work; lowest U at equal theta, and at equal cost while E/k <= 4 (C2c)
C2a.what: MoE routing, padded: E=4 experts, top-1, 1 layer, d_model 4; every position runs every expert

C2b.mechanism: M4 charged advice: ceil(log2 E) bits per chosen expert per position per layer; route_check VU folds into ok
C2b.notes: exact route description 20 bits, charged 24 (byte granularity); ok word: +16 output bits per request and reach inflation (U 144 vs 112); description 42473 vs 45592 bytes at 7 tokens: each distinct route pattern is its own definition, so the advised description grows with the routed positions (see C2c at 128 tokens).
C2b.verdict: the honest server's pick once E/k is large (from E=16, k=1 under the VU-output interior, C2c): k/E of the expert compute for k*log2(E) bits per position, spent on a stronger theta
C2b.what: MoE routing, advised: the same shape and requests; the route is advice, only chosen experts run

C2c.mechanism: M5 vs M4 compared at equal theta (equal relative overhead) and at equal absolute prover cost
C2c.notes: E=2,k=1: gates padded/advised 1.29x (96017 vs 74171), description 29861 vs 55300 bytes, |a| 160 b over 128 tokens; at theta=(1/2,1/8) capacity 2048 vs 2720 (overhead 0.615 vs 0.614); at equal absolute cost 90367: padding 2048 vs advice 2720 -> padding | E=4,k=1: gates padded/advised 1.86x (143833 vs 77326), description 34718 vs 83330 bytes, |a| 320 b over 128 tokens; at theta=(1/2,1/8) capacity 2048 vs 2880 (overhead 0.614 vs 0.613); at equal absolute cost 135116: padding 2048 vs advice 2880 -> padding | E=8,k=1: gates padded/advised 2.95x (247145 vs 83726), description 48351 vs 90253 bytes, |a| 480 b over 128 tokens; at theta=(1/2,1/8) capacity 2048 vs 3040 (overhead 0.612 vs 0.613); at equal absolute cost 228933: padding 2048 vs advice 2759 -> padding | E=8,k=2: gates padded/advised 2.31x (247145 vs 107027), description 48351 vs 168771 bytes, |a| 960 b over 128 tokens; at theta=(1/2,1/8) capacity 2048 vs 3520 (overhead 0.612 vs 0.614); at equal absolute cost 228933: padding 2048 vs advice 3520 -> padding | E=16,k=1: gates padded/advised 5.03x (484489 vs 96388), description 89470 vs 141217 bytes, |a| 640 b over 128 tokens; at theta=(1/2,1/8) capacity 2048 vs 3200 (overhead 0.608 vs 0.611); at equal absolute cost 433847: padding 2048 vs advice 1544 -> advice
C2c.verdict: at equal theta padding beats advice in U at every (E, k), by |a| plus the ok words; at equal absolute prover cost advice wins from E=16, k=1 on (E=2,k=1:padding, E=4,k=1:padding, E=8,k=1:padding, E=8,k=2:padding, E=16,k=1:advice)
C2c.what: MoE crossover sweep: (E, k) in {(2,1), (4,1), (8,1), (8,2), (16,1)}, 32 requests x 4 tokens, theta grid q in {1/2, 1}, s in {1/8..7/8}

C3a.mechanism: M5 in-circuit acceptance: eq per position, prefix product, masked slots, V entries masked by the flags
C3a.notes: 11 tokens; 2313.2 gates/token vs 991.3 advised; outputs 29 slots (blank = vocab) vs 11 tokens; U = 464 bits (capped); gamma=4: 45491 gates, U 752. The blanks make each step's m output-determined (route c, not taken).
C3a.verdict: never the honest server's pick: (gamma+1)x the target positions and the interface, max_new-1 steps
C3a.what: speculative decoding, padded: gamma=2, target d_model 4, draft d_model 2 (random weights), 2 requests

C3b.mechanism: M4 charged advice: ceil(log2(gamma+2)) bits per step; acceptance_check VU folds 'exactly m agree' into ok
C3b.notes: acceptances ((0, 0, 0, 0, 1), (0, 0, 0, 1)) (18 exact bits, charged 24); perfect draft (= target): acceptances ((2, 2), (2, 2)), 8 advice bits, 16563 gates; gamma=4 random draft: 32 advice bits (27 exact), 10904 gates; ok word +16 bits per request. The token count is output-determined; each m is not.
C3b.verdict: the honest server's pick: the target does exactly plain decoding's positions plus the draft's
C3b.what: speculative decoding, advised: the same models and requests; m per step is advice
